### [Multi-Vector (Late Interaction) Embedding Models with Sentence Transformers](https://huggingface.co/blog/multi-vector-encoder)

**Hugging Face** · 2026-08-18

Sentence Transformers has added native support for multi-vector late interaction encoder models like ColBERT.

- Sentence Transformers v3.4+ supports late interaction architectures that retain fine-grained token-level representations rather than collapsing inputs into a single vector.
- Late interaction models compute similarity via MaxSim (maximum similarity) between token pairs across query and document representations.
- The implementation allows fine-tuning and inference for multi-vector models using the standard SentenceTransformers interface.

**Why it matters:** Developers can now train and deploy state-of-the-art token-level retrieval models using the familiar Sentence Transformers library without needing specialized frameworks.

### [Mojo🔥 is now open source](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Aug/18/mojo-is-now-open-source/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-08-18

Modular has officially open-sourced the Mojo programming language's compiler and toolchain under an Apache 2 license following its 1.0 release.

- Mojo's compiler and toolchain are licensed under Apache 2.
- The 1.0 version shipped last week prior to the open-source release.
- Mojo has pivoted from its original goal of being a strict Python superset to an independent language with Python-inspired syntax optimized for GPU programming.
- AI-assisted coding tools are currently being utilized to help migrate legacy Python code to Mojo.

**Why it matters:** Developers gain open access to a Python-inspired language and toolchain explicitly optimized for GPU programming and AI code migration.
